description: From nullable-user-fields.patch.json: Make user-like fields (anything ending in _by, plus user/owner/assigned_to/primary_account) nullable across PostHog schemas. The spec marks them as non-null $refs but the API regularly returns null when the user has been deleted, when the request was made by an anonymous/system actor, or when the field is unset. Without this patch, decoding fails on every list response that contains an entry with a deleted/system user.
